mobbin:f693c13b-9f45-4762-a988-c8e65b456.summary: User starts from empty Workflows templates, scopes a team workflow, builds Pre-call Disclaimer with trigger Before event starts, attaches selected event types, adds attendee then host emails, saves, and sees it Active on event type(s).
steps: Workflows empty — Create + reminder template cards
New workflow for… personal vs team
Editor — Apply to all checkbox; 24h before; email attendees
Named Pre-call Disclaimer; event type Select…
Event type multi-select open — Team Quick Chat etc.
Offset 60 mins; Apply to all still available
Add action modal — Send email to host
Action 3 — Send email to host + Include calendar event
Saved — toast Pre-call Disclaimer workflow updated
List — Pre-call Disclaimer; Active on 1 event type
steal: Which event type will this apply to? multi-select plus Apply to all, including future event types (steps 2–6).
Linear When (before start + offset) → Do this action cards (steps 2–7).
List card shows Triggers … and Active on N event type (step 11).
avoid: Reminder-only actions (email/SMS) across 12 steps — no auto-record/announcement actions Essentials needs per phase.
mobbin:f693c13b-9f45-4762-a988-c8e65b456.fit: Best map for per-scenario automation: rule set on selected event types (= SCE templates) like today's prep-email / auto-record defaults, as a reusable When/Do builder.
